# Your Taxi Man — Rwanda Private Chauffeur & Airport Transportation

> Ride safe, arrive happy. Reliable, premium private transportation, airport transfers, city rides, and bespoke tourism experiences across Rwanda.

## Overview
- **Business Name**: Your Taxi Man
- **Location**: Kigali, Rwanda (Operating Countrywide)
- **Primary Contact / WhatsApp**: +250 788 910 995
- **Email**: semazaemmanuel@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/your_taxi_man/ (@your_taxi_man)
- **Availability**: 24/7 by advance reservation
- **Accepted Payments**: Rwandan Francs (RWF), US Dollars (USD), Mobile Money (MoMo), Cash

## Core Services
1. **Kigali Airport Transfers (KGL)**
   - Punctual pickups and drop-offs for Kigali International Airport (KGL).
   - Real-time flight tracking, personalized terminal meet-and-greet with name placard, and luggage assistance.
2. **Kigali City Chauffeur & Daily Hire**
   - Private executive driving for business meetings, conferences (e.g. Kigali Convention Centre), shopping, dining, and city errands.
   - Dedicated driver on standby.
3. **Tourism & Safari Travel across Rwanda**
   - Gorilla trekking transfers to Musanze & Volcanoes National Park.
   - Scenic leisure trips to Lake Kivu (Rubavu / Gisenyi, Karongi / Kibuye).
   - Game drive safari transfers to Akagera National Park, Nyungwe Forest Canopy Walk.
4. **Corporate & Diplomatic Delegations**
   - Discreet, courteous, professional transport for NGOs, embassies, business delegates, and VIP guests.
5. **Countrywide & Cross-District Rides**
   - Safe long-distance travel across all provinces in Rwanda.

## Fleet & Standards
- Clean, comfortable, well-maintained, air-conditioned vehicles (sedans, SUVs, 4x4s).
- Experienced local chauffeur fluent in English and French.
- In-depth local knowledge of Rwanda routes, road safety laws, and scenic destinations.

## How to Book
- Direct WhatsApp booking: Send travel date, pickup location, destination, and passenger count to +250 788 910 995.
- Online Booking Page: Visit /book to submit details directly into a pre-filled WhatsApp message.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: How far in advance should I book?**
  A: Same-day reservations are welcome depending on availability, but booking at least 12–24 hours in advance guarantees vehicle allocation and airport meet-and-greet preparation.
- **Q: Are prices fixed or metered?**
  A: Transparent flat-rate quotes agreed upon prior to dispatch. No hidden fees or unexpected surge pricing.
- **Q: Do you track delayed flights?**
  A: Yes, for all airport arrivals, flight numbers are monitored in real time so drivers adjust arrival times automatically.
